OG0000050: NB-LRR Foliar Disease Resistance Sentinel
The Genomic Burden of Being Evergreen:
V. peripherica underwent 86 stringent family expansions (plus
22 rate-sensitive expansions), demonstrating a substantially higher
expansion profile than V. tubiflora (56 stringent, 11 rate-sensitive).
Year-round photosynthesis under high UV and vapor pressure deficit
demands continuous protein quality control (F-box ligases +51),
cell wall turgor sensing (LRR-RLKs +57), and constant pathogen
V. tubiflora avoids foliar maintenance costs by dismantling thylakoids
into dormant desiccoplasts, investing selectively in plastid import
(TOC/TIC +55) and NDH redox buffering (+29) for rapid rehydration.
